CustomField.description: Calculated grade level based on student age at the time of assessment.
CustomField.formula: IF( TEXT(Individual_Application__r.Account.Student_Type__c) <> "New", "N/A", CASE( FLOOR( ( DATE(YEAR(TODAY()),12,31) - Individual_Application__r.Account.PersonContact.Birthdate ) / 365.2425 ), 4, "PK", 5, "K", 6, "1", 7, "2", 8, "3", 9, "4", 10, "5", 11, "6", 12, "7", 13, "8", 14, "9", 15, "10", 16, "11", 17, "12", /* Default when not matched */ IF( FLOOR( ( DATE(YEAR(TODAY()),12,31) - Individual_Application__r.Account.PersonContact.Birthdate) / 365.2425 ) >= 18, "College", "N/A" ) ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Calculated grade level based on student age at the time of assessment.
CustomField.label: Age-Appropriate Grade
